work.text: What compactness and dignity are given to the mass in which we find Christ, by the two tufted trees that surmount it ! … And what a glamour of beauty is lent to the scene by the lances and torches of the soldiers — lines that are and are not parallel

source.author: Bernard Berenson
source.title: The Central Italian Painters of the Renaissance

moment.text: Giotto had painted the same betrayal in Padua only a few years before (c. 1303–05). Set side by side, Duccio's crowded, many-figured night scene and Giotto's single locked gaze between Christ and Judas show the two founders of Italian painting at work on one story.

matters.text: Motionless, in the middle of the foreground, we see the figure of Christ. … the Pharisee elders at the sight of His face, which betrays no feeling but pity, start back
